_help: Story map: the player's route through the whole island, read by game/map/island_miniature.tscn (the 3D miniature). Edit the numbers, save, and re-run the miniature to see the change. Coordinates are the game's world metres: x = east, z = south (north/up the mountain is NEGATIVE z), y = height above sea level. Route points: [x, z] = on the ground (height taken from the terrain); [x, z, y] = at that exact height (underground or in the air). status: built = a level scene exists; proposed = this map's suggestion, nothing built. Everything not 'built' is PROPOSED and open to change. Terrain beyond the built levels (west coast, summit, north coast) is the miniature's own guess, see game/map/island_height.gd.

stages.name: Beach
stages.note: The captain drops you. The black stone is out past the point.

stages.name: Ravine
stages.note: Scaffold collapses behind you: the way back to the beach is gone.

stages.name: Old Harbor
stages.note: Shed, watchtower, searchlight. The gate chain is cut as the stone rises.

stages.name: Base Camp
stages.note: Supply depot. Power the cable car (generator, fuel, breakers).

stages.name: The Line (cable car)
stages.note: The ride up. The car stops dead beside pylon 3.

stages.name: The Fall
stages.note: The ladder rung gives way. Blackout. You wake in the old village (the drag marks lead from the foot of the buried steps).

stages.name: The Old Village
stages.note: Carvings, the colonist's log, the dig site, the burned quarter. PROPOSED CHANGE: the exit is the south-west rim gap, not the cargo lift (see MAP.md, conflicts).

stages.name: Down to the coast
stages.note: A gully path from the village rim down 115 m to the west coast. One-way (steep, loose).

stages.name: The colonial ship wreck
stages.note: The captain's ship, beached in the cove. Through the hull, then wade along the waterline under the cliff to the sea cave (the cave is entered from the water).

stages.name: The sea cave
stages.note: Entered from the water. Tide pools, the colonist's smuggling cache.

stages.name: The underground tunnel
stages.note: A man-made tunnel, old timbers and newer concrete. It meets the natural cave system.

stages.name: The cave system
stages.note: Natural caves, the longest climb of the game (about 170 m up). Where 'the hollow under the island' lives. Underground river, the god's old place.

stages.name: Research-center bunker
stages.note: The company's bunker: a sealed door at the cave end, then a long lift shaft up (about 75 m) to the research center basement.

stages.name: Research center
stages.note: The compound at the top of the cable line (upper station). Survey team's labs, the owner's office. Then a service road up to the next facility.

stages.name: Second facility
stages.note: Name and purpose TBD. The last building before the summit: the ritual's control room / the owner's dying body?

stages.name: The summit: the ritual site
stages.note: The circle, the three crystals, the open void. Where Elias, the researcher and the owner met. The finale.

side_routes.name: Cable line to the upper station
side_routes.note: The line really runs to pylon 4 at z -390. The map extends it to the research center's upper station.

side_routes.name: Service path (surface, bypassed)
side_routes.note: The lit fenced path (Ch3) that leads up to the research center on the surface. In this route the player does not take it; see conflicts.

side_routes.name: Village cargo lift (Ch4 ending)
side_routes.note: Ch4 currently ends by riding this lift up to the service path. Conflicts with 'village leads to the wreck'.
